name: Chaos Spawn

bonuses.name: Mutative
bonuses.text: Any time a Chaos Spawn deals a Wound, the GM gains 1 Ruin.

bonuses.name: Second Strike
bonuses.text: This Threat reduces the Multi-Attack penalty by 2DN, as though it had the Dual Wield Talent (Wrath & Glory, page 133).

abilities.name: Unnatural Regeneration
abilities.text: Whenever a Chaos Spawn rolls a 6 on the Wrath Die, the Torment regains 1D3 Wounds.

note: Reprint of chaos-spawn; differs in a wholly different profile (Core: Large, 10 Wounds, Elite) and Tier row. Print: Wrath text says 'the Torment regains' (copied). Same stats as dh-torment.
